description: This file exports utility functions related to plugin SDK entry points, including generating source paths, specifiers, package exports, and distribution artifacts based on a JSON list of entry points.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkEntrySources
methods.description: Generates an object mapping each entry point to its source file path.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkSpecifiers
methods.description: Creates an array of module specifiers for each plugin SDK entry point.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkPackageExports
methods.description: Builds an object mapping export paths to their corresponding type definitions and JavaScript files.

methods.name: listPluginSdkDistArtifacts
methods.description: Returns a list of distribution artifact file paths for all plugin SDK entry points.
